children: U.S. energy distributor's fiscal 2026 adjusted diluted EPS beat analyst expectations
Adjusted net income and adjusted diluted EPS declined yr/yr
Company completed infrastructure upgrades and divested LPG operations in seven countries
UGI forecasts fiscal 2027 adjusted diluted EPS of $2.90-$3.20
Company says fiscal 2027 adjusted diluted EPS guidance assumes normal weather and current tax regime
COLDER WEATHER AND RATE INCREASES - FY26 Utilities segment benefited from colder temperatures, higher base rates, and increased core market volumes, boosting margin and operating income
LPG DIVESTITURES AND LOWER VOLUMES - FY26 UGI International's margin and volumes declined due to divesting LPG businesses in several countries, partially offset by currency translation effects
LOWER AMERIGAS VOLUMES - FY26 AmeriGas Propane earnings fell as customer attrition, the Hawaii divestiture and warmer weather in the western U.S. reduced retail volumes
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the natural gas utilities peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for UGI Corporation is $44.00, about 15.6% above its November 18 closing price of $38.05
The stock recently traded at 12 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
